title: Improvising, Princess Margaret, Robert Merrill, and symphony versus jazz feeling
summary: Armstrong explains how he improvises around the lead, mentions playing for Princess Margaret and singing with Robert Merrill, and says jazz is subjective while symphonic playing is objective. He recalls playing silent pictures in a 1925 Chicago theater orchestra and Cavalleria rusticana.
